messages:
Elliot: Heads-up from the usability run: compare table layout feels brittle when the left filter rail is open. People lose the latency column and then get frustrated.
Priya: We also got feedback that performance badges draw the eye too strongly and compete with metric values. They read like decorative stickers.
Ava: Two quick options: collapse filter rail by default in compare mode, or make the metric columns sticky. Both have tradeoffs re: space and discoverability.
Marco: Sticky columns look promising but will need an explicit z-index plan and reduced header height. We should show a subtle shadow to indicate separation.
Tess: Badge redesign idea: reduce visual weight — small circle + short text, or icon-only with aria-label on focus. Hover expands a mini tooltip with full context.
Elliot: Important a11y point: color-only status on badges isn't sufficient. Add visible text or pattern, and ensure aria-labels read full metric + status.
Priya: Copy tweak: change badge abbreviations like "P95" to "Latency (p95)" in tooltip and screen-reader label. Keeps things clearer for non-ML readers.
Ava: Pin behavior confusion: users assumed pinning applies to current filters but it persists globally. Suggest adding a microcopy hint when pinning: "Pin model version globally" and an option "Pin to current filters" in the menu.
Marco: UX motion: animate the pin action — tiny scale + fade into a persistent banner that appears in the header saying "Pinned: v2.4.0". That should reinforce global scope.
Tess: Keyboard order issue: tabbing goes from row actions to badges, causing unexpected jumps. Proposed order: checkbox -> primary metric -> actions -> badges. We'll test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
Elliot: Mobile behavior: hide secondary badges and show a single summary chip "+more" which expands inline. Keeps rows compact on small widths.
Priya: Localization note: keep badge labels concise for languages with longer strings; tooltips should contain full translated metric name.
Ava: I'll prototype a compact-badge system and a +n overflow; Marco can try sticky column + pin banner variant.
Marco: I'll also write an engineering checklist for z-index, hit targets (>=32px), and animation performance.
Tess: I'll own the a11y acceptance criteria: contrast, aria descriptions, and keyboard/focus order.
DesignBot: Reminder to add localization keys and small copy tickets to the PR.
Elliot: Plan: review Figma frames next Tues. Please add a short screen recording of the overflow and pin animation.
Priya: Noted 55 I'll add i18n owners to the ticket.
Ava: Thanks team, posting mocks shortly.
